steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Octavian (later Augustus) was Caesar's adopted heir who defeated Mark Antony at Actium (31 BC) to become Rome's sole ruler

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The Second Triumvirate (43 BC): Octavian, Antony and Lepidus divided the Roman world; it ended in civil war between Octavian and Antony

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Augustus established the Principate: he held supreme power but maintained Republican forms and titles (Princeps = First Citizen)

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: The constitutional settlement (27 BC): Augustus 'restored the Republic' but kept consulship, tribunician power and control of key provinces

steps.body: Actium = 31 BC, Octavian defeats Antony Principate = monarchy disguised as Republic (Princeps = First Citizen) Constitutional settlement (27 BC): 'restored Republic' but kept real power Pax Romana = 200 years of stability after decades of civil war
